source: CardInsider extraction pipeline (v3.1.1 baseline) + redemption_rules transform v1
_note: Apply links for 219 cards, moved here from PR #85 (which targeted main and is being closed). Each card gains apply_url, the issuer's own product page for that card, plus a per-field _provenance entry recording the source URL, fetch date and the controls it passed (HTTP 200 on the issuer domain, no offsite redirect, page carries an apply action, not a PDF). Nothing else changes: verified card by card that removing apply_url and its provenance entry gives back dev 5.2.0 byte for byte, so no reward rule, cap or rule_name moves. The schema gains the optional apply_url field (same 5 lines as #85). Why dev and not main: promote copies dev's cards.json over main's whole, so links that exist only on main would be deleted by the next publish. App v2.36.5 reads apply_url; 2.36.3 does not.
